description.value: Sharky's Chophouse & Eatery is a steakhouse housed inside the iconic Lonsdale Quay Market on the North Vancouver waterfront, with over 15 years serving locals and visitors. The restaurant specializes in premium cuts of steak and chophouse classics made with locally sourced ingredients, and offers views of the North Shore mountains and Burrard Inlet. Its location at the Lonsdale Quay ferry terminal makes it a convenient stop for cyclists crossing between Vancouver and the North Shore.
